newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria has 166 mln levs Q3 trade surplus. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria has 166 mln levs Q3 trade surplus. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]

text.p: Bulgaria posted a trade surplus of 166 million levs in the third quarter of this year after a surplus of 9.37 billion levs in the second quarter, trade minister Atanas Paprizov said on Friday.
Exports amounted to 3.286 billion levs and imports to 3.120 billion levs, he said. (Corrects imports figure)
"Due to stagnating production and financial instablity the trade surplus is much lower than expected," Paparizov told a news conference.
Bulgaria's largest turnover was in trade with countries of the European Union, where Germany had the largest share in Bulgaria's imports.
